history.name: Family and Child Protection Society
history.description: The Family and Child Protection Society in Irbid was established in 1992 and works to protect the family and childhood through an integrated set of programs and projects. The society seeks to provide various services including social and psychological care, vocational training, and economic empowerment for the most needy groups.
